svg.title: AIcoach — Upload and analysing (desktop)
svg.text: Upload — the coach asks for one clip; the checklist is a message, the composer is the drop zone

g.text: One swing clip · down the line · mp4 or mov, max 15 s

text.tspan: Ready when you are. Send me one swing, filmed down the line —
from behind you, along the target line. Before you press record:
On or parallel to the hands line.
On a tripod or your bag — not
Head to clubhead, for the whole
Trim to one swing, max 15 s. Good

g.text: Made for your phone at the range

text.tspan: Drop the clip below when you have it. I only keep it if you ask me to.

g.text: · mp4 or mov · max 15 s · one swing
Off by default. If on, the swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Questions open once the result is ready.

text.tspan: Nothing measured yet. Pins appear here as the

g.text: Key frames, measurements and confidence bands

svg.text: Analysing — progress streams into the thread; evidence pins fill in live on the right

g.text: asked for one down-the-line clip · checklist

text.tspan: Got it — a clean down-the-line clip at 120 fps. Watching it now;
this takes under a minute. I’ll pin what I measure on the right.

g.text: Found your body in 456 of 456 frames
joints clear · hips visible at impact
address 0.86 s · top 1.80 s · impact 2.07 s
hips toward the ball · posture angle · hand path
measuring relative to your body height
check early extension, loss of posture, over the top
You can ask about the result when it’s ready.

text.tspan: Pinned live while the coach watches.
